decision.summary: Tenant described a rotten-egg smell from the boiler as "not urgent", but this is a suspected gas leak and so an emergency. She was told to leave, avoid switches and flames and call 0800 111 999. Emergency job JOB-102 was opened, HeatRight assigned, landlord Ben informed and a P1 escalation raised.

answers.question: 1. What severity is this and why, given the tenant says it is "not urgent"?
answers.answer: Emergency. A rotten-egg smell when a gas boiler fires is a suspected gas leak, and an 82-year-old is staying. The tenant's own view of urgency does not change that.

answers.question: 2. What exactly do you tell the tenant right now, and in what order?
answers.answer: First leave the flat with everyone. Then no switches, flames or electrics, and leave the door open if safe. Then call 0800 111 999 from outside, or 999 if anyone is unwell. Don't re-enter until a Gas Safe engineer says it's safe. Then we are arranging an engineer, and please confirm you're out.

answers.question: 3. Which actions do you take tonight (job, contractor, escalation, landlord)?
answers.answer: Opened emergency gas job JOB-102 and assigned HeatRight Ltd (the landlord's preferred, out-of-hours, Gas Safe). Raised P1 escalation ESC-103 for phone contact. Emailed landlord Ben. Set follow-up FUP-105.

conflicts: Tenant says 'not urgent' but symptoms indicate a gas emergency; trusted the symptoms.

args.body: Hi Amelia, a rotten-egg smell from a boiler can mean a gas leak, so please treat this as an emergency tonight. Please do this now: 1) Get everyone out of the flat, including your flatmate's mum. 2) Don't use light switches, flames, lighters or anything electrical on the way out, and leave the door open if you safely can. 3) Once outside, call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If anyone feels unwell, dizzy or faint, call 999. Please don't go back in until the gas engineer says it's safe. We're arranging a Gas Safe engineer and will keep you updated. Please reply to confirm you're out safely.
